user: How does the review process work and how long does it take?
answer:
Once a dispute is opened, the review target depends on the type of payment:

- **Card transactions:** 10 business days.
- **Transfers:** 20 business days.
- **Complex cases with a foreign acquirer:** up to 45 calendar days. You would be notified if your case falls into this category.

You will receive a notification at every change in the dispute's status. Before a case is resolved, you can withdraw it at any time. Be aware that a withdrawal is final, and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

The transaction we discussed is eligible under service_not_rendered, and I have not opened the dispute yet. Once you confirm that you want me to file it, I will submit it. Do you want to proceed?

fragments.text:
Complaints
## Difference from a dispute
A dispute concerns a specific transaction. A complaint concerns the service
itself: a delay, an error, or the conduct of an agent. The two follow separate
processes.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Complaints
## Acknowledgement and resolution
A complaint is acknowledged within one business day and resolved within 15
business days. Complex complaints may take up to 35 business days, with the
customer informed of the delay.
